name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ミオリネ・レンブラン

description.ja: ガンダムシリーズ最新作『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』より、ミオリネ・レンブランがFigure-rise Standardシリーズにラインアップ！
description.en: From the latest Gundam series "Mobile Suit Gundam Witch of Mercury", Miorine Remblanc is now available in the Figure-rise Standard series!

description.ja: ■豊富な表情はタンポ印刷済みパーツ１種と、水転写式デカール用パーツ2種で再現。ミオリネのクールな表情を演出できるよう、細部まで徹底追求。
description.en: • The rich expressions are reproduced with one type of tampo-printed part and two types of water transfer decal parts. We have thoroughly pursued every detail to create Miorine's cool expression.

description.ja: ■髪型はパーツ構成を考慮し、立体的な形状を再現。後ろ髪は可動し、背中にアクションベースを取り付ける時にもスペースを確保できる。
description.en: • The hairstyle takes into consideration the parts composition and reproduces a three-dimensional shape. The back hair is movable, allowing space to be secured when attaching the action base to the back.

description.ja: ■制服の色分けはパーツ分割により再現。肩や胸元の装飾は付属シールで表現。
description.en: • The color coding of the uniform is reproduced by dividing the parts. The decorations on the shoulders and chest are expressed with the included seals.

description.ja: ■脚部の関節は自然なシルエットを意識しつつ、可動域を確保。
description.en: • The leg joints maintain a natural silhouette while ensuring range of motion.

description.ja: ■靴を脱いだ状態の足パーツも付属し、付け替えることが可能。
description.en: • Foot parts with shoes removed are also included and can be replaced.

description.ja: ■ジョウロとシャベルが付属。
■ハンドパーツは繊細な指先まで表現。ジョウロ、シャベルを持つことができるハンドパーツも含め、左右３種が付属。
description.en: • Hand parts depict delicate fingertips. Three types, left and right, are included, including hand parts that can hold a watering can and shovel.

description.ja: ■ポージングを支えるディスプレイ用台座も同梱。
description.en: • A display pedestal to support posing is also included.
